rejected_rule.statement: Proceedings have commenced only when steps are taken in terms of section 136(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: That is when the persons identified as 'suspects' previously become identified as 'accused' and is the point at which the right to commence a prosecution has been exercised and the relevant point for the purposes of section 456 of the Code of Criminal Procedure [Queen v. Don Louis(supra)].
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 136(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure
